summary: A multi office Sydney family law and estates firm appears to lose enquiries to thin proof, repeated read more links and an unclear contact form.

findings.problem: Only one unattributed testimonial appears, with no ratings, review counts or case outcomes.
findings.cost: Clients choose a firm they can see proof for.

findings.problem: Calls to action appear to repeat as Find out more and Read More many times.
findings.cost: Vague buttons do not tell a visitor what happens next.
findings.fix: Clear action labels such as Book a free fee discussion.

findings.problem: The contact form appears to ask for Other Party and show office options run together.
findings.cost: A confusing form causes abandoned enquiries.
findings.fix: A simple form with name, phone and matter type.

findings.problem: No lawyer names appear on the homepage and no booking option or WhatsApp appears.
findings.cost: Clients hire a person, not a logo.
findings.fix: Lawyer profiles and an instant booking button.

redesign: Clear buttons and a simple form.
